description: Pinned base-image digests for the kernel-v1 OCI bake. Every image is pinned by digest (never mutable tag). Resolve fresh digests with: docker buildx imagetools inspect <image>:<tag>. Updated 2026-07-22.

rust-builder.description: Rust 1.95 slim builder image for compiling agent and control-plane binaries. Used only in builder stages; never shipped in runtime images.

agent-runtime.description: Distroless cc (glibc + libgcc) runtime for the kernel-v1 agent. Holds /usr/local/bin/kernel-v1-agent and /opt/kernel-v1/bpf/*.bpf.o. No shell, no package manager, no compiler.

control-plane-runtime.description: Distroless cc (glibc + libgcc) runtime for the kernel-v1 control-plane. Holds /usr/local/bin/kernel-v1-control-plane and /opt/kernel-v1/migrations/. No shell, no package manager, no compiler.

postgres.description: PostgreSQL 16 Alpine for the control-plane database in production compose.

kafka.description: Confluent Platform Kafka 7.7.0 (KRaft mode) for the production event bus.

clickhouse.description: ClickHouse 24.8 server for the production analytics/event store.
